title: Unit Event — Parallel Harmonies — Episode7 Taking Those Feelings On

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need is finally going to start writing its debut song! However, Mr. Shindo has a request: that Saki and Ichika compose it together. The pair are determined to make it a great song, but things don't go so smoothly...

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: After talking to Miku and the others, I feel like we might actually be able to do this now...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I have a much better idea now as well...
I know what I was doing wrong.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Unlike you and the others, Miku, I wasn't really listening to what Saki was saying...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought I was doing a good job of respecting her thoughts, but I started placing my own ideas above hers somewhere along the way...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At least, that's what I think...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I was doing the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Instead of understanding what you wanted, Ichi, I began putting my ideas first... I became so stubborn and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We ended up having a little fight...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm really sorry, Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's okay, Saki...
I'm also really sorry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But why did we end up fighting...?
I honestly believed I was being really careful about respecting your thoughts, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe that happened because you have different convictions as creators.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Convictions...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. Beliefs and ideas that you're not willing to bend. I have to think anyone with a creative mind has at least a few of those...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You and Ichika are no exception, Saki.
Naturally, not all of your beliefs are going to mesh together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think that's it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: On the other hand, there's nothing wrong with two creators butting heads in the process of making something...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Many incredible songs have been born out of such conflicting feelings.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, what we did wasn't wrong?
That's okay...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but... That doesn't make things any easier...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, if we try to weave our thoughts and feelings together, won't that lead to another argument...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, for this song, Saki, I'll try turning your feelings into music.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I... I also think that it's going to be hard to get our feelings to mesh together coherently.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I think I can do what Miku and the others just did. If I listen better and keep my mind more open, then I believe we'll succeed...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm going to take in everything you've been talking about. What kind of song you want it to be, and what kind of sound you want to achieve. I'll build from there...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What about how you feel...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not like I'm going to completely sweep my own feelings off to the side. However, I do believe this is our best option for success right now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I want to do what I can to make sure our listeners hear your message, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, I want to be able to do what Miku and the others just did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They've been there to listen this whole time. They've given me so much...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whenever I was writing lyrics or working on a song, they were always willing to lend an ear.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which resulted in me being able to turn my feelings into music... I realize that now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, next...
I want to help make your music come to life.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like Miku and the others did with me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's make the most amazing song ever...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You helped us make an important realization.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now, we should be able to write a great song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We really appreciate it, since this is sort of our only way of helping you girls.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your only way...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Our only way of helping is by assisting in turning your feelings into music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We can't write our own songs like you can, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We can only listen to your thoughts and produce music based on that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We always wish we could do more to help...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I couldn't be happier that we were able to lend you both a hand like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good luck, you two.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to you producing the best song ever.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks!
